scope_note: A 429 blocks one method in one workspace for one app. Other methods and other workspaces are unaffected.

tier_3.notes: paginating collections of conversations or users

special.notes: unique per method; chat.postMessage is ~1 msg/sec per channel

pagination_caveat: published tier applies only when using cursored pagination; unpaginated full fetches get stricter limits

non_marketplace_2025_change.reason: prevent bulk data exfiltration by unvetted applications

message_posting_per_channel.bursts: short bursts allowed; sustained excess can permanently disable the app

burst_policy: Slack does not publish burst numbers; design target is 1 request/sec per method

429.retry_after: seconds until retry — not a date, not an epoch
429.scope: this method, this workspace, this app

app_rate_limited.note: informative event, not an HTTP error

retry_guidance.primary_fix: one backoff bucket per (workspace, method) pair
retry_guidance.backoff: honour Retry-After seconds, then exponential with jitter
retry_guidance.do_not: do not delay unrelated methods; Slack does not
retry_guidance.disable_risk: continuing after a rate limit can permanently disable the app

escape_hatch: use Events API instead of polling conversations.history; scope reads to a thread with conversations.replies; apply for Marketplace approval if history access is genuinely required
